title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a motivated and customer\-oriented Desktop Support Engineer with around 1 year of experience to provide day\-to\-day software support to our internal users. You will assist in troubleshooting software issues, installing applications, supporting remote users, and ensuring smooth functioning of desktop systems and software tools.

Key Responsibilities:

* Assist with troubleshooting software errors, crashes, and application performance issues.
* Support remote users via remote desktop tools like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or RDP.
* Log and track support tickets in the helpdesk system and follow up with users.
* Set up new user systems, software environments, and user profiles.
* Assist with maintaining software inventory and license tracking.
* Escalate complex issues to senior support staff or system administrators.
* Follow standard IT procedures and contribute to documentation where necessary.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or certification in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
* **1 year of experience** in an IT support or desktop support role (internships or freelance work not acceptable).
* Familiarity with Windows and/or macOS environments.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, antivirus software, and common productivity tools.
* Understanding of how to install, configure, and troubleshoot software applications.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Job Type: Full\-time

Benefits:

* Paid time off

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a skilled Desktop Support Engineer to provide technical assistance and ensure smooth IT operations across the organization. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting, system maintenance, and user support.

**Location:** Prahladnagar, Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1 \- 2 Years

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Key Responsibilities**
* Provide technical IT support and resolve day\-to\-day IT issues.
* Install, configure, and support standard software applications, including Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues on desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve network and connectivity issues related to LAN/WAN, routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Install, configure, and maintain computer systems, operating systems, servers, and network devices.
* Install, configure, and support Windows 10/11 and Windows Server environments.
* Manage and administer Active Directory users, groups, computers, and Group Policies.
* Administer and support Microsoft 365 (Office 365\) services and applications.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot firewalls, VPNs, and network security solutions.
* Configure and support network devices, including switches, routers, and wireless controllers.
* Provide first\-level support for network\-related incidents and service requests.
* Monitor and maintain LAN WAN, Wi\-Fi, and Internet connectivity.
* Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, and switching issues.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain endpoint security and antivirus solutions.
* Monitor system performance and ensure IT infrastructure availability.
* Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of network infrastructure.
* Maintain accurate inventory records of hardware, software, licenses, and IT assets.
* Maintain network documentation, IP address records, and network diagrams.
* Monitor firewalls and assist in implementing network security policies.
* Document IT procedures, configurations, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for hardware, software, and network support when required.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT security policies and best practices.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

title: IT Resume Specialist
description:
Resume Writer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** IT Recruitment / Career Services  
**Shift:** Overnight(US time zone)

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **Resume Writer** who can create, improve, and customize professional resumes for IT professionals. The ideal candidate should understand different IT roles, be able to identify candidates' key skills and experience, and present them effectively in ATS\-friendly resumes.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and update professional, ATS\-friendly resumes for IT candidates.
* Review candidates' experience, skills, projects, and career goals.
* Customize resumes according to specific IT job descriptions.
* Highlight relevant technical skills, achievements, and experience.
* Ensure resumes are professionally formatted, accurate, and easy to read.
* Optimize resumes with relevant keywords for ATS systems.
* Rewrite existing resumes to improve their impact and presentation.
* Work with recruiters and candidates to gather required information.
* Maintain quality and consistency across all resumes.
* Complete resumes within assigned timelines and meet daily/weekly targets.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in resume writing, career services, recruitment, or a related field.
* Excellent written English and strong grammar skills.
* Strong knowledge of professional resume formatting and ATS optimization.
* Good understanding of IT/technical roles such as Software Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, etc.
* Ability to understand technical experience and convert it into strong resume content.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and handle multiple candidates.

Preferred Skills

* Experience creating resumes for the **US job market**.
* Familiarity with US IT recruitment and job descriptions.
* Experience using resume\-building or document\-formatting tools.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and keyword optimization.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional growth opportunities.
* Training and development.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with IT professionals and US\-based recruitment processes.
